title: STN local field potentials from awake Parkinson's disease patients ON and OFF medication, with and without DBS (Wiest et al. 2023)
description: Subthalamic nucleus (STN) local field potentials recorded together with scalp EEG and accelerometers from patients with Parkinson's disease, 3-6 days after DBS surgery while the leads were externalised. Recordings were made OFF and ON dopaminergic medication, at rest and during 130 Hz STN deep brain stimulation sessions. The data underlie an analysis showing that the aperiodic exponent of STN field potentials increases with levodopa and with DBS, reflecting excitation/inhibition balance.
methods_description: STN LFPs were recorded from externalised DBS leads (Medtronic, Boston Scientific or Abbott) using TMSi Porti (2048 Hz) or TMSi SAGA32 (4096 Hz) amplifiers, with scalp EEG and accelerometers. Stimulation used a custom in-house neurostimulator delivering symmetric biphasic constant-current 130 Hz pulses at the middle contacts. Recordings were made at rest and during stimulation sessions, OFF and ON medication, and exported from Spike2 to MATLAB, then converted to BrainVision format.
